key_decisions.rationale: Preserves growth, language-cultural groups, complaint, gendered widows, neglect, and daily service.
key_decisions.before: In those days, as the number of disciples was increasing, a complaint arose from the Hellenists against the Hebrews because their widows were being overlooked in the daily distribution.
key_decisions.after: In those days, as the number of disciples increased, the Greek-speaking Jewish believers began complaining against the Hebrew-speaking believers because their widows were being overlooked in the daily distribution.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Now in these days, as the disciples were increasing in number, there arose a complaint of the Hellenists against the Hebrews, because their widows were being overlooked in the daily distribution.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps Twelve, whole community, judgment, word, and table service without belittling it.
key_decisions.before: The twelve called together the whole community of disciples and said, “It would not be right for us to neglect God’s word in order to serve tables.
key_decisions.after: So the Twelve called the whole community of disciples together and said, “It would not be right for us to neglect God’s word in order to serve tables.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And the twelve, summoning the multitude of the disciples, said, “It is not pleasing for us to neglect the word of God to serve tables.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves community address, exact number and gender, reputation, Spirit, wisdom, appointment, and task.
key_decisions.before: Therefore, brothers and sisters, select from among you seven men with good reputations, full of the Spirit and wisdom, whom we can appoint over this responsibility.
key_decisions.after: Brothers and sisters, select from among you seven men with good reputations, full of the Spirit and wisdom, whom we will appoint over this responsibility.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Therefore, brothers, select from among you seven men of good reputation, full of the Spirit and wisdom, whom we will appoint over this need.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves communal approval, all seven names, Stephen’s qualities, Nicolaus’s status, and origin.
key_decisions.before: This proposal pleased the whole community. They chose Stephen, a man full of faith and the Holy Spirit; Philip, Prochorus, Nicanor, Timon, Parmenas, and Nicolaus, a convert to Judaism from Antioch.
key_decisions.after: This proposal pleased the whole community. They chose Stephen, a man full of faith and the Holy Spirit, along with Philip, Prochorus, Nicanor, Timon, Parmenas, and Nicolaus, a convert to Judaism from Antioch.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And the word pleased the whole multitude, and they chose Stephen, a man full of faith and the Holy Spirit, and Philip, and Prochorus, and Nicanor, and Timon, and Parmenas, and Nicolaus, a proselyte of Antioch.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves synagogue name, regions, movement, and dispute.
key_decisions.before: But some people from the synagogue called the Synagogue of the Freedmen, along with Cyrenians, Alexandrians, and people from Cilicia and Asia, rose up and argued with Stephen.
key_decisions.after: But some members of the synagogue called the Synagogue of the Freedmen—including people from Cyrene, Alexandria, Cilicia, and Asia—rose up and argued with Stephen.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: But some of those from the synagogue called that of the Freedmen, and of the Cyrenians and Alexandrians, and of those from Cilicia and Asia, rose up disputing with Stephen.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves covert instigation, male witnesses, accusation, Moses, and God.
key_decisions.before: Then they secretly prompted men to say, “We have heard him speaking blasphemous words against Moses and God.”
key_decisions.after: Then they secretly induced men to say, “We heard him speak blasphemous words against Moses and God.”
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Then they secretly instigated men to say, “We have heard him speaking blasphemous words against Moses and God.”

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves false testimony, persistent-speech charge, sanctuary, and law.
key_decisions.before: They set up false witnesses who said, “This man never stops speaking against this holy place and the Law.
key_decisions.after: They set up false witnesses who said, “This man never stops speaking against this holy place and the law.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: and they set up false witnesses who said, “This man does not cease speaking words against this holy place and the Law;

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps reported claim, Jesus’ full identification, destruction, customs, Moses, and tradition.
key_decisions.before: We have heard him say that this Jesus the Nazarene will destroy this place and change the customs Moses handed down to us.”
key_decisions.after: For we heard him say that this Jesus the Nazarene will destroy this place and change the customs Moses handed down to us.”
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: for we have heard him saying that this Jesus the Nazarene will destroy this place and will change the customs that Moses handed down to us.”

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves whole council, sustained gaze, face, and angel comparison.
key_decisions.before: Everyone sitting in the council looked intently at Stephen and saw that his face was like the face of an angel.
key_decisions.after: Everyone sitting in the council stared at Stephen and saw that his face was like the face of an angel.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And all those sitting in the council, looking intently at him, saw his face like the face of an angel.
